new.statement: Chapter-numbered escape incrementals (Punch Walls To Escape CH3, 1M Clicks To Escape CH2, Punch Out Of Prison Chapter 2) stay on Up-and-Coming by shipping new chapters but settle in its lower half, while chapter-based racers like Build and Burn turn chapters into strong revenue per player
new.rationale: Today Punch Out Of Prison and 1M Clicks To Escape are among the weakest Up-and-Coming games and collect-upgrade-rebirth loops sit at the 13th percentile, while Build and Burn [CHAPTER 3] is among the most efficient Top Earning games at 27 days. Confirm if chapter-tagged games keep chart presence longer than untagged games of the same loop, and whether the revenue side holds beyond one racer.

qualitative_updates.note: On the first day of November horror and Halloween titles led the falls: WARDEN -60 and Survive the Killer! -38 on Top Trending, It Hears The Water -26/-19/-28 and Scary Shawarma Kiosk -26/-31 on Most Popular and Top Trending, A Long Flight [HALLOWEEN] -14 on Most Popular. One day only; the week decides.

Ragdoll Playground entered Most Popular at 35 days, Ragdoll Sandbox and Ragdoll Physics 2 entered Up-and-Coming at 16 days, Realistic Ragdoll Engine holds #27 Most Popular and #7 Top Trending at 20 days; 'Ragdoll' titles split Top Trending at r=+0.71 and Up-and-Coming at +0.36.

It Hears The Water fell on three charts at once (-26 Most Popular, -19 Top Trending, -28 Up-and-Coming) while DONT SPLASH holds #3 Most Popular and #2 Up-and-Coming: the wave may be consolidating into the original.
Scary Shawarma Kiosk reversed yesterday's +43 with -26 on Most Popular and -31 on Top Trending as Halloween ended; Ice Cream Shop [Anomaly] entered Up-and-Coming at 19 days.

+1 Anime Eyes (+206 at 18 days), +1 Titan Evolution (+173 at 27 days) and Throw Food For Animals (+156 at 44 days) led Top Earning risers, the third straight day of young breakouts' revenue catching up.
uc→tt now 156 entries (median 2 days) and tt→mp 135 (2 days), with tt→uc still 1.

Steal mechanics rank higher on Up-and-Coming today (r=+0.50, 8 games) and Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular, which argues against a fading template; steal-defend-base remains the weakest earner per player.
